notes.title: Looking for testers! Also new demo in works
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this announcement is pretty delayed but I forgot to mention that when Next Fest ended, I removed the demo as based on the very low playtimes, it seemed that the game was too confusing or boring and likely left a poor impression. 

Honestly, after having play-tested it more myself, I also found a lot of aspects somewhat tedious and so I've had to change several things.

For example, the whole manual player caravan system is no longer needed, and you can just send trade routes to other towns without the destination needing a market since it's one-way anyway. This makes it so that taking new towns and getting supplies set up isn't as annoying and drawn out as it was before.

There has also been a lot of bug fixes and such, and basically the demo was pretty outdated so I decided to remove it for now, and later on when the game is in a more stable state, I'll upload a newer demo that is just a limited version of the main game.

Multiplayer stuff was changed a bit too, although since that wasn't available in the demo, nobody would notice the changes. But yeah, multiplayer is a thing too! And speaking of multiplayer...

Looking for Testers!

One thing that I can't really test on my own is the multiplayer aspect of the game, and while I've requested a lot of test keys, I don't really have people to help test the game. 

If you're interested, you can just respond here, and I'll pick at random people to test (although given the small follower count, I probably won't have to do that). Unlike the demo, the test key would just be the full game, and multiplayer should work. If you have any friends you wanted to try it with, you can let me know and I can provide multiple keys.

There's not really any obligation if you're a tester, you can just play the game and if you have any comments or if you find any bugs you can let me know through the steam forums.

Thanks for checking the game out!
